derivation: Every declared voltage is re-expressed in mV and every current in mA (e.g. nominal_v 5 V -> {"value":5000,"unit":"mV"}). units.py converts to canonical SI before normalisation, so the normalised model - and therefore the semantic hash and the plan hash - must be byte-identical to the base plan. This guards against floats leaking into the plan or unit-dependent comparisons.
